proofBoundary: Point lookup verifies its bounded visited Patricia path, not untouched global closure. Caller supplies an admitted snapshot, scratch admission and GC protection. Mutable traversal shares the existing reader algorithm and only permits staging through its supplied source; it grants no selected-root authority. Independent tree bytes cover all registered hashes and explicit absence/prefix branches. Real native read-back/reopen and every compiled binding are checked through point lookup without changing HEAD. Allocation tests prove the newly owned lookup digest/identity/prefix buffers are recoverable; no universal allocator or I/O recovery claim is made.
